name: Carboplatin
mechanism: Forms DNA crosslinks similar to cisplatin but with slower aquation kinetics, resulting in a different toxicity profile. Dosed to a target area under the curve based on estimated renal function.
keyToxicities: Hypersensitivity reactions (risk rises with repeated exposure)
resistance: Shares mechanisms with cisplatin, including enhanced DNA repair and reduced drug accumulation; in BRCA-associated tumours, reversion mutations restore homologous recombination.
